Job Title: Data Scientist - Wealth Management / Retail Banking

Experience: 6 to 10 Years

Location: Pune / Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full-Time

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Scientist to join our Data Platforms team. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, and AI-driven solutions, with hands-on experience in the Wealth Management or Retail Banking domain or any BFSI domain.
